9801aa7009b47aa79b29ee0725695452.overview: From Paris to Venice to Broadway to Hollywood, the lives of Cole Porter and his wife, Linda Lee Thomas were never less than glamorous and wildly unconventional. And though Cole's thirst for life strained their marriage, Linda never stopped being his muse, inspiring some of the greatest songs of the twentieth century.
9801aa7009b47aa79b29ee0725695452.tagline: A love that would never die and music that would live forever.

982d1f438a4f58c5767bebcbcb0abe33.overview: Ghost is an ideological musician and leader of a jazz band who would rather play his blues in the park to the birds than compromise himself. His peripatetic performances lead him to cross paths with a singer, while his masculinity is thrown into question following a violent brawl.
982d1f438a4f58c5767bebcbcb0abe33.tagline: The Bold Story Of A Man Caught Between Two Strange Loves!

9833966281d3023a6bff912007828f61.overview: A gang of jewel thieves hides out in an abandoned London house after a robbery, unaware that a detective is among them in disguise.
9833966281d3023a6bff912007828f61.tagline: A great play. A great novel. And a greater film.

9837ce056cb590f9225d7d6adb1c76fd.overview: Winnie's life is less than wonderful one year after saving her town from a psychotic killer on Christmas Eve. When she wishes she was never born, she finds herself magically transported to a nightmarish parallel universe. With the murderous maniac now back, she must team up with a misfit to identify the culprit and get back to her own reality.
9837ce056cb590f9225d7d6adb1c76fd.tagline: This Christmas, your wishes will come true... and your nightmares too.

98b619669823b8b6c6243ebe53eff1c3.overview: Ema is a magnetic and impulsive dancer in a reggaeton troupe. Her toxic marriage to choreographer Gastón is beyond repair, following a decision to give up on their adopted child Polo. She sets out on a mission to get him back, not caring who she’ll need to fight, seduce or destroy to make it happen.

98d48d84943718f19df831b8ed8e53c2.overview: An ex-fighter pilot is forced to take over the controls of an airliner when the flight crew succumbs to food poisoning.
98d48d84943718f19df831b8ed8e53c2.tagline: What's slower than a speeding bullet, and able to hit tall buildings at a single bound?
